description: Capture complete full-page screenshots or PDFs of any list of URLs. The actor scrolls lazy content, waits for images and fonts, removes fixed headers and consent overlays, and reports blocks and truncation honestly.

colorScheme.description: Request the site's light or dark theme through prefers-color-scheme where the site supports it.
colorScheme.title: Color scheme

cookieBannerAction.description: Hide common cookie and consent overlays, click Accept first, or leave them untouched.
cookieBannerAction.title: Consent banners

delay.description: Additional milliseconds to wait after navigation before scrolling or capturing.
delay.title: Extra delay after load

delayAfterScrolling.description: Milliseconds to wait after scrolling and before capture. Only used when scrolling is enabled.
delayAfterScrolling.title: Delay after scrolling

device.description: Device preset. Custom uses the viewport width, height and scale factor below. Presets emulate a real mobile or desktop browser.
device.sectionDescription: Viewport, scale, color scheme and language for the browser.
device.title: Device

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel density for Device=Custom: 1 is standard, 2 is retina, 3 is high-DPI mobile. Device presets use their own scale factor.
deviceScaleFactor.title: Device scale factor

format.description: PNG is lossless, JPEG and WebP are smaller, PDF produces a printable document. WebP conversion uses Pillow after the browser capture.
format.title: Output format

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page. Turn off to capture only the visible viewport. A selector overrides this option.
fullPage.title: Capture the whole page

hideFixedElements.description: Hide real fixed headers, full-screen overlays and chat widgets before capture. Sticky content blocks are left in place. Default off because resetting to the top already prevents repeated headers on most pages.
hideFixedElements.title: Hide fixed headers and overlays

locale.description: Locale used for navigator.language and localized pages.
locale.title: Browser language

maxConcurrency.description: How many URLs to capture in parallel. Keep at 1 for long pages at 2048 MB; higher values need more memory.
maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent URLs

maxPageHeight.description: Clip full-page images at this CSS height. 0 means unlimited. PDFs keep their full document height and ignore this limit. Truncation is reported in the record.
maxPageHeight.title: Maximum page height

maxRetries.description: Retry transient navigation failures and block pages. Retries use the AUTO datacenter proxy when no user proxy is configured.
maxRetries.title: Retries per URL

maxScrollSteps.description: Stop after this many scroll steps. Prevents infinite-scroll pages from running forever. A cap hit sets truncated=true in the record.
maxScrollSteps.title: Maximum scroll steps

navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for navigation and selector readiness per URL.
navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout

pdfFitOnePage.description: Create one tall PDF page instead of paginated paper. Overrides the paper height but keeps the selected margins.
pdfFitOnePage.title: Fit the whole page on one PDF page

pdfLandscape.description: Use landscape orientation for PDF pages.
pdfLandscape.title: Landscape PDF

pdfPageSize.description: Paper size for PDF output. Web page width preserves the previous 1280 px wide / Letter-height behavior.
pdfPageSize.sectionDescription: Only used when Output format is PDF.
pdfPageSize.title: PDF page size

pdfPrintBackground.description: Include CSS backgrounds, colors and images in the PDF.
pdfPrintBackground.title: Print backgrounds

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy override. The actor starts direct and uses an Apify AUTO datacenter proxy only after a real block when this is empty. Residential is never selected automatically.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

quality.description: Quality for JPEG and WebP output (1-100). Ignored for PNG and PDF.
quality.title: Image quality

scrollStepPx.description: Pixels to scroll per step. Smaller steps trigger more IntersectionObserver content but take longer.
scrollStepPx.title: Scroll step

scrollToBottom.description: Scroll through the page in steps to trigger lazy images, infinite-scroll widgets and content-visibility sections before capture.
scrollToBottom.sectionDescription: Controls for lazy content, fixed elements and consent overlays.
scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to load lazy content

selector.description: Optional CSS selector. When set, captures only that element and ignores fullPage. Example: main, #pricing, article.
selector.title: Capture one element

selectorsToHide.description: Comma or newline separated CSS selectors for extra elements to hide before capture. Example: .newsletter-popup, #chat-widget
selectorsToHide.title: Additional CSS selectors to hide

urls.description: Web pages to capture. Each item can be a URL object or a plain URL string. Bare domains such as example.com are accepted and use https.
urls.title: URLs to capture

viewportHeight.description: Browser viewport height in pixels when Device is Custom.
viewportHeight.title: Viewport height

viewportWidth.description: Browser viewport width in pixels when Device is Custom.
viewportWidth.title: Viewport width

waitForFonts.description: Wait up to 5 seconds for web fonts to finish loading.
waitForFonts.title: Wait for fonts

waitForImages.description: Wait up to 5 seconds for images to finish loading after scrolling. Incomplete images are reported in warnings.
waitForImages.title: Wait for images

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before capture. Useful for single-page apps. Fails the URL if the element never becomes visible.
waitForSelector.title: Wait for element

waitUntil.description: Navigation readiness. DOM content loaded is the fastest reliable default; network idle can stall on analytics-heavy sites.
waitUntil.sectionDescription: Controls for deciding when the page and its assets are ready.
waitUntil.title: Wait until

waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScroll.description: After scrolling, wait until the network is idle before capture. Uses the timeout below.
waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScroll.title: Wait for network idle after scrolling

waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScrollTimeout.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for network idle after scrolling.
waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScrollTimeout.title: Network idle timeout

title: Screenshot URL Input
